objects.name: Saudi shutdown of key pipeline limits oil flow as Yemen hits back against Houthis
objects.description: Saudi Arabia has closed a critical oil pipeline after it was struck by drones launched from Iraq, the latest squeeze on Middle Eastern supplies after attacks by Iran-backed Houthi rebels this week threatened to deepen the world’s energy crisis.
